extracted.intended_audience: Mathematics researchers/authors submitting manuscripts to the Journal of Algebraic Geometry
extracted.subtask_description: Preparation and submission rules and editorial procedures for authors who wish to publish research papers in the Journal of Algebraic Geometry. Covers file format, author information, abstract and reference requirements, typesetting expectations, and the editorial review process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial submission file format
rubrics_metrics.description: A PDF file of the manuscript should be submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit the manuscript as a PDF for initial submission (link provided on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Typesetting for accepted manuscripts
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuscripts accepted for publication must be typeset by the author in AMS-LaTeX.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors are responsible for typesetting accepted papers using AMS-LaTeX; follow the AMS macros and conventions when preparing final files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial and refereeing process
rubrics_metrics.description: The handling editor obtains expert opinions and referee reports; if favorable, the editor may ask for revisions and may propose the manuscript to the full Editorial Board; the Board votes to accept or reject; Board members may seek further reports or revisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect peer review with possible revision requests. The handling editor manages referees and may escalate to the Board based on referee recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author contact information provision
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors should supply the Editor with an email address (if available) and current postal address (if applicable) with their affiliation on the last page of the manuscript; these will be printed at the end of each article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide up-to-date contact details on the manuscript's last page; to avoid publication delays, notify the journal of any changes (email address provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Update of author information before proofs
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors are encouraged to send changes in postal and email addresses (especially before proof has been sent to authors).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Send updates to the provided editorial email to prevent incorrect information being printed; once an article is published electronically, author information cannot be updated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language of submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors are encouraged to submit manuscripts written in English.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author name order
rubrics_metrics.description: All author names must be in First-Middle-Surname order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the name order on the manuscript matches this format for printing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affiliations and email listing
rubrics_metrics.description: All authors' affiliations and email addresses must be fully listed at the end of the paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include full institutional affiliations and email addresses for every author on the final page as they will be printed with the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract requirement and length
rubrics_metrics.description: An abstract is required for every paper; the abstract should be at least one complete sentence and at most 300 words.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal provides free worldwide access to electronic abstracts; craft a concise abstract within the 300-word limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style guidance for manuscript preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: To eliminate unnecessary delay or difficulties in printing, authors may be guided by 'Mathematics into Type' (updated edition, AMS, 1999).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the recommended style practices in the referenced guide to reduce production issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Footnote policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Footnotes should be avoided except for a possible acknowledgment of assistance or financial support on the first page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid footnotes in the body of the paper; confine any necessary acknowledgments to the first page.

rubrics_metrics.name: References formatting and order
rubrics_metrics.description: References will be published as submitted; the list of references must be in alphabetical-chronological order; abbreviations of names of journals and references to books should follow the standard form established by Mathematical Reviews®.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide references in the requested order and abbreviation style (links to journal abbreviations and MathSciNet examples provided). Examples of typical reference entries are shown on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic publication timing and consequences
rubrics_metrics.description: Articles are electronically published after proof is returned from authors and before appearing in an issue; once an article is published electronically, author information (such as postal and email addresses) cannot be updated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that electronic 'early view' publication happens after proof stage; make sure all details are final before returning proofs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Display order of published papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Papers are displayed alphabetically by first author listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The online listing of 'Articles in press' and recently published articles is ordered alphabetically by the first-listed author.
